notes.title: RAM V1.0.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! Its been a fun couple of days seeing everyone's reaction to the final game as people make their way though the stages and story. Thanks once again to everyone that played the open beta and helped make the launch so smooth.[/p][p]That being said there were a few small issues that popped up over the last couple of days, so this patch addresses the majority of those issues:[/p][p][b]Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new Epitaph Breakthrough Upgrade: Subcriticality, removes the juggle cap on orbs[/p][/*][*][p]Rally trickshot now scales linearly when stacked[/p][/*][*][p]Frame Interpolation now shortens the pre-sweetspot arc time of orbs[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Stage 1 shop prices by ~20%[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented Shielded Enemies antiupgrade giving enemies swap shields during final boss fight[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted menu music to be the updated track from the OST[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Solidarity would be obtained multiple times[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Thistle and Epitaph skin unlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some Elite skins not displaying[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Cuckoo memories not greying out[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some menu spacing issues with other languages[/p][/*][*][p]Many localization and typo fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Known Issues which will be addressed later this week/early next:[/p][list][*][p]Sol and Puukko can have an overlapping cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Ending can have layering issues[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad Thistle issues[/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue to monitor bug reports and feedback so please keep them coming![/p]

notes.title: RAM 1.0 BETA PATCH V0.9.7
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, we are just over a week out from RAM's 1.0 launch! [/p][p]Thank you all for helping us work out the kinks. We've put a new build out on the public testing branch, and we would be super grateful if anyone testing could start a new save file to make sure the game works from the beginning, and all the sequencing works. [/p][p]The main thing still missing is beating the game on a Fresh File run, so don't expect that beating the final boss on your first run will make any sense right now. In fact, if possible when testing, please try to imagine what a first time player is experiencing so we can address the most common issues.[/p][p] Here are the changes and fixes since the last patch: [/p][p][b]Adjustments[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added new level 3 intro tease and slimmed down intro tutorial,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced starting dialogue amount when returning from the first run,[/p][/*][*][p]Turned off the combo system during the final boss,[/p][/*][*][p]More than one memory can now appear in a run (1 per Stage),[/p][/*][*][p]Solidarity now requires playing the Mail Sorting Minigame 3 times,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a re-read tutorial button to the Horde Mode menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 3 levels now display exit markers,[/p][/*][*][p]Added some failsafes for the final boss to avoid softlocks,[/p][/*][*][p]Ambush Tachis will no longer drain the combo meter,[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Cuckoo reaction dialogue (no more dying after 23 floors),[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses are now invulnerable until the fight starts,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Regularization cost curve,[/p][/*][*][p]Rallying epitaph orbs now gives a trickshot bonus (RALLY x1.5),[/p][/*][*][p]Piercing irbs now work with pitching arm,[/p][/*][*][p]Killing multiple enemies with piercing laser now gives a trickshot bonus (LASER PIERCE x1.2),[/p][/*][*][p]Final boss now benefits from Open Source,[/p][/*][*][p]Memories can now be shared with Cuckoo after swapping with Ira,[/p][/*][*][p]Daily run upgrades now weighted for what bots can appear,[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 3 levels can now appear when in the shop,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where level 3 bots skins were not being reset when resetting save,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a dialogue portrait could get misaligned,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bounced bullets would disappear,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain memories would not grey out,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where open source notes.title: RAM V0.8.2 PATCH NOTES
notes.content: [p]Hello RAM heads, just a small update today to ease onboarding of new players. There are no bug fixes in this update as we have been working on the 1.0 content which addresses many of the issues that have been reported since the last patch.[/p][list][*][p]New beginner encounters: Stage 1 levels before the first shop will have reduced enemy variety until the CPU has been beaten once, to avoid the steep learning curve of dealing with all 4 bot types at once. After the CPU has been defeated, normal encounters will spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]New swap reminder: A reminder to swap will appear over the current host's head when at low health until the player has met Thorn twice. We often see that new players forget they can swap and we hope this will be a small nudge that will go away once players have a handle on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased warning vignette intensity for when the player cannot swap[/p][/*][/list][p]On another note, RAM is on sale again for the next two weeks 20% off! As always, please consider leaving us a review.[/p][p]We plan to have the 1.0 content in open testing in the next week or two, so if you haven't already, check out our discord server for details on when and how to be a part of it! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/rYZMgespCC"]https://discord.gg/rYZMgespCC[/url][/p][h2][/h2]

tags.feature: New beginner encounters: Stage 1 levels before the first shop will have reduced enemy variety until the CPU has been beaten once, to avoid the steep learning curve of dealing with all 4 bot types at once. After the CPU has been defeated, normal encounters will spawn.

New swap reminder: A reminder to swap will appear over the current host's head when at low health until the player has met Thorn twice. We often see that new players forget they can swap and we hope this will be a small nudge that will go away once players have a handle on it.

notes.title: The Ash Grove Update
notes.content:
Hello RAMmers!

It's finally time for RAM's second major early access milestone, The Ash Grove Update!
We've been hard at work on making the world feel more alive and making each run and time back in the hub feel more meaningful. This update caps off the planned content for Ash Grove and its residents, although more memories will be added over time.

Next up will be our 1.0 update later this year where you will get to experience the final area, the last two bots, and conclude the main story.

[h2][b]NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Ashen Citadel questline[/b][/h3]
    New Aphid minigame!
    Infiltrate the Aphid stronghold and smuggle contraband to a peculiar fugitive.
    Check the the fire escape in the large apartment building to the East of the river
[h3][b]Mysterious Tachi[/b][/h3]
    Rescue an odd character from Dojigiri’s fortress.
[h3][b]Router minigame[/b][/h3]
    We can’t really call this one a questline, but you can throw mail and stuff!
[h3][b]Steeltoe questline conclusion[/b][/h3]
    There’s finally more story to unlock by playing Horde Mode.
[h3][b]Memory system[/b][/h3]
    Find curious locations in runs and show them to Cuckoo (or others???)
[h3][b]Accessible Ash Grove 6 residences[/b][/h3]
    You can now break into almost every house in Ash Grove 6.
[h3][b]2 new skins[/b][/h3]
    One is hidden
[h3][b]New upgrades[/b][/h3]
    Unlocked via the new quests
[h3][b]Super Mysterious Uber-Upgrades[/b][/h3]
    These are complete placeholders for now. You get them from completing questlines.

This update also fixes several bugs and adds requested features like Save Resetting (which can be found under Gameplay settings when on the Main Menu).

As always, we are keen to hear your feedback and any bugs you may experience, so please consider joining our discord server if you haven't already: https://discord.gg/Rhp6vPCvgb

Thank you to everyone for the continued support!

- Xylem Studios

RAM V0.7.2

Hello RAMheads, thank you for your patience with us getting this patch out! We are hard at work on the next set of updates, and the Level 3 bots are coming along well, keep an eye out for our first newsletter sometime soon!
Please be aware of an issue with some of the latest NVidia drivers that may cause visual issues with the game.

Bug fixes and adjustments:
[list]
[*] Fixed an interaction with Router grenades that could break the game’s audio
[*] Improved visibility and placement of traffic barrier doors in level 2
[*] Improved window positioning when changing game resolution
[*] Removed panning effect from level selection map to resolve gamebreaking issue on certain systems
[*] Fixed missing/misplaced wall collision in some floors
[*] Prevented skipping an encounter in the Atrium floor
[*] Fixed an exploit that allowed debug commands to be used without enabling debug tools
[*] Made collider tackles less likely to clip past targets at high speed
[*] Fixed Heap orb laser DPS not changing when time is slowed
[*] Fixed Collider lasers not visually stopping after piercing max number of enemies
[*] Fixed an issue where endscreen upgrades would not be cleared properly and could display tooltips
[*] Fixed an issue where the start menu link buttons would not open anything
[*] Fixed an issue where the style histogram could not be hidden on the endscreen during the fade out
[*] Fixed an issue where doing a speedrun restart could display an incorrect histogram
[*] Fixed an issue where the aim line toggle could not be selected on gamepad
[/list]

notes.title: RAM V0.6.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch addresses much of the feedback we have received over the past few days (and also buffs Router). We are continuing to monitor feedback and will address lingering bugs in the coming days, thanks to everyone for reporting and sharing your thoughts! 

Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Added a slider for Fitness Jammer VFX in Accessibility options
[*] Added a slider for Background Dialogue Speed in Accessibility options
[*] Added a Speedrun mode which unlocks in the Gameplay options after beating the level 2 boss. Enabling this mode will add a Restart Run button to the End Run Summary screen, allowing you to not have to return to Ash Grove 6 between runs
[*] Skins can no longer be unlocked in practice mode or with debug mode on
[*] Increased hitbox of Level map swap points
[/list]

notes.title: RAM V0.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch addresses most of the issues found on the first day. There are some issues we are still investigating and will fix asap, such as the cursor jittering on the map.
We have been reading the feedback and will continue to adjust things over the week! Thanks for a great first couple of days and all the positive reviews!

Adjustments:

Removed restrictions on fishing
Lowered the damage the Heap took from physics based attacks
Adjusted stack size font to be more legible on smaller resolutions
Adjusted doors in Staff Room and Coolant to avoid potential softlocks

Boss 2 Adjustments:

Heap orbs can no longer be possessed by the MITE until their shields are broken
Heap orbs no longer regenerate their shields after they break
Heap orbs now have healthbars after their shields are broken
Increased heap HP from 3000 to 3500
Decreased Heap orb HP from 500 to 400
Severing Heap orbs now deals 600 damage to the Heap instead of 500, but the damage no longer scales with modifiers like Deviance
Removed Heap's 50% weakness to physics damage
If Heap orbs are forced to drop enemies OOB, the enemies now die instantly
Changed Heap score to 1500, and orbs score value to 300 (previously they were all ~2000 due to a bug)
Damage from Efficiency no longer scales with modifierse like Deviance, and Efficiency now treats Heap orbs as bosses (doesn't instantly kill)
Fixed severing Heap orbs dealing negative damage to the Heap when at low health

Tachi Specific Fixes:

Fixed Tachi clipping OOB with True Focus (it should be less likely at least)
Fixed True Focus not targeting enemies standing too close to destructible objects
Free sabers no longer deal damage at low speeds
Killing enemies with sword stabs no longer gets the sword stuck mid-air until the enemy despawns
Decreased "ting" noise spam from free sabers

Fixes:

Fixed an issue where level 2 music was not looping
Fixed some Heap fight issues and softlocks (we are still investigating some edge cases for this and the CPU)
Fixed some issues with Achievements triggering (they should now trigger the next time the action occurs if missed the first time)
Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the charging state after fishing
Fixed an issue where you could move with the Perimeter Defense Menu open
Fixed an issue where tutorial enemies could be replace with level 2 bots
Fixed an issue where EVL could be earned in practice mode
Fixed some visual layering issues
Fixed some typos and incorrect strings

notes.title: Development Update 3
notes.content:
Hello RAM enthusiasts!

We wanted to share a short development update on the progress of the game as we move into December.

In case you missed it, Devlog 3 was released, all about a new bot, the Collider! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/acb8cd31d81b4510eeb988dad09d8f5b29e9f331.png[/img]
Check it out here:
[previewyoutube=EB6c0xhf2vs;full][/previewyoutube]
Collider is one of the bots that will be released when RAM enters early access next year, along with another saber-wielding member of the post Patch world.

We are hard at work creating new levels and encounters, here is a small tease of what is to come:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/cb4f7c7f3f634e2bd08bb805421d4ec169402770.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/578dd01164d35f055313a157a7d9d9daa90d3310.png[/img]

In the new year we will have more to share about the story and world as well as the scope of early access, and we will be updating the demo to include the overhauled level 1 art. If you want more updates and teases on what we are cooking, come join our community discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/Fr2ueDCeun]Xylem Studios Discord[/url]

We wish everyone a happy and safe holiday season, go destroy some robots in the demo to keep warm!

notes.title: Development Update 1
notes.content:
Hello fellow RAMmers!

Welcome to the first of doubtless many updates. Development is progressing well, and our quest to find artists was successful. In this update, we're excited to show you the fruits of their labor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/44938145f6bfdc48d4a85c87cc42e1b871a0a9d8.png[/img]

This logo is the first taste of RAM's proper aesthetic, which we're in the process of propagating throughout the game. Along with this, of course, the characters are being rebuilt from the ground up.

Introducing the new and improved Chainbot - aka "Deadlift".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/eba8541446103d4d74ade2ec1224fedd563d7005.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/c2079ee068c9347927e266fcf411b28f1d0fa046.gif[/img]

And the Shotgunner - aka "Steeltoe"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/a3f4862538173efc2e95ecadf025c57db8261527.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/13e0320c4357be873b9860a96b99d58eaa96c4ad.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates on the rest of the bots, new gameplay screenshots, and look forward to a public demo sometime this summer!
